_comment: Port St. Lucie — GENERATION B workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check. Note the metro spans St. Lucie and Martin counties, so Stuart / Jensen Beach / Hobe Sound / Palm City rows are in-metro.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Port St. Lucie, FL MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 2 MSA counties (St. Lucie, Martin), Martin (Florida)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 18 geocoded venue(s) of 24 in this batch (observed lat 27.0567..27.4692, lng -80.3829..-80.1333).
msa: Port St. Lucie, FL (St. Lucie, Martin counties)
_reconcile_comment: One venue matches a dormant source='osm' status='draft' row, adjudicated SAME venue by court-verifier on 2026-07-31. UPDATE keyed on osm_id, never an INSERT. COUNTY FLAG RESOLVED, NO ACTION: court-verifier noted Langford Park sits in Jensen Beach, Martin County and suspected the batch was mis-tagged. It is not. The Port St. Lucie MSA comprises Martin AND St. Lucie counties — that is the exact county pair this metro's envelope was derived from — and the venue falls inside it. Correctly tagged; do not re-tag it and do not audit the batch for this. Owner ruling 2026-07-31.

reconciles.note: SAME venue as the dormant OSM row (59 m — the OSM feature is the court polygon, the research geocode is the 2369 NE Dixie Hwy rooftop). access_type keeps the research value 'public' (the OSM row already agrees at 'public'), and the reconcile supplies the city, address, metro_area, fee_type and website the OSM row lacks entirely.
